_what: Town Center building massing, photo-interpreted from georeferenced aerial imagery.
_why_this_file_exists: Karen asked for the Town Center buildings and pointed out that they appear on Minto's
site plan. They do -- but Minto's plan is licensed to her for use as-is, and its footer
forbids reproducing, altering or deriving from it, so it cannot be traced. Everything
below was measured off the ground instead.
_why_not_automatic: Every authoritative source was checked first and none covers this ground:
* Bay County GIS building footprints (Basic_Layers/MapServer/21) return 96 features
in the query box, all east of lon -85.863 near Hwy 79. No Town Center coverage.
* OpenStreetMap has zero buildings in the Town Center box.
* Extracting them from Minto's plan by colour failed: a 600 dpi crop of that window
has 20+ blended tones with none over 5%, because it is a textured illustration
rather than flat vector fill. The boxes that came out landed on the pickleball
Automatic extraction from the aerial also fails, and it fails for a measurable reason:
sampled off the imagery, a white roof reads 203, the bandshell plaza 186, a blue-grey
roof 183 and parking asphalt 159, all at saturation 0.05-0.24. Brightness separates
built surfaces from vegetation (62) and water (39) cleanly, and nothing separates a
roof from the car park beside it. So a reader has to say where the building ends --
which is exactly how OpenStreetMap building footprints are made.
_how_measured: Google satellite imagery, georeferenced against the same 73-pond control network used
for the marina pad, the dog park clearing and the kayak launch; this shot solves at
1.0146 m/px. A metre grid was drawn from that georeference and each block read against
it, then drawn back onto the imagery and checked (tools/map/work/_tcmass.py).
Positions are metres east/north of the Town Center marker at the origin below.
_accuracy: +/-5 m. The imagery is 1.01 m/px and Google's own place markers sit over part of the fitness centre. Published as indicative massing, never as survey, and styled so it reads as approximate.
_naming: Only the fitness centre is named, because Google independently places its own
'Fins Up! Fitness Center' marker on that roof. The other three are real buildings
measured in the right place, but nothing confirms which business each one is, so they
stay unnamed. Reading names off the arrangement of Minto's plan would be a guess
wearing a label, and the amenity list is printed alongside instead.
_dropped: A fifth block south of the poolside pavilion was measured and then dropped: that ground
is bright paving plus one of Google's place icons, and a roof could not be told from a
pool deck there. An unverifiable block is left out rather than shipped.
_not_included: The tennis and pickleball courts are the one Town Center surface with a colour
signature of their own -- a court samples b-r = +65 against +18 to +28 for roofs and
asphalt -- so unlike the buildings they could be thresholded and contour-traced
automatically. They are left out of this pass only because Karen asked for the
buildings; if the racquet courts are wanted, they can be snapped rather than read.
